title: Functional Fortnight
author: Cooper L.
desc:
Achieve a busy but well rounded training program. 

Rest days are included in program. Not all 14 days are working days

ex.note: More time if needed
Use smith machine to get deep and explode up
Train until failure
Warm up your back. Keep light and don't fatigue early

Take this exercise to failure, which can be done safely because of the application of the cable
Keeping your elbows wide and pulling to a higher point on your torso will involve more of the rear dealt

Narrow grip
Once failure is reached, continue to eek out a few more partial reps as we know that partial reps after reaching failure produce more growth.
Once you reach concentric failure on the straight arm pushdown, row the handles towards you, triceps push it down, and then try to control the eccentric lowering of the weight stack
On the bottom end of the rep,you will be holding in the stretch position for an ascending ladder. Rep 1 = 1 second hold, rep 2 = 2 second hold, keep going until failure
Complete 1 set until failure, use assistance if you need too

Reps = Kilometre 

If you can't run, Get a good walk in
10 minutes of stretching and or foam roller at home
30 minutes of HIIT, find a saturday class if possible. If not use cardio equipment in gym or quick temp run. Group training is ideal as it will push you
Downward pyramid reps. If you can do 10 start, there and work down. Finding a starting number and try to increase through the program
Overhead with cable
Focus on the stretch if it doesn't hurt
1 set will actually be 2. Left and Right side done separately

Buiuld up to adding weight.

May want to do yoga first, depends on workout structure/availability
10-15 reps both sides is a set
Join a class or following along with an online video. Going for flexibily yoga as opposed to strength and conditioning yoga.
will be hard but keep pace slow to not fatigue to much
Front to back and side to side, 12x each leg. Good for mobility
Don't work off max rep. Work off your weight for your final set of 5. Build through the program
Keep slight bend in knees don't lockout at the top. No more then 2 mins rest
1 second pause at the top, slowly lower down and then back up, drop the weight through the set if needed but get the 10 reps in
Fuel yourself properly for this workout and hit each muscle group hard, you'll have time to recover
add weight if possible, or use assistance if needed, slow on the way down
Finish with a forearm exercise of your choice

1 rep = 1 km
